text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included (passport type must be ordinary) 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3. High school academic transcript Official transcripts of your academic achievement up to the present, including courses taken and standard achieved (original documents or certified copies in Chinese or English) 4. High school graduate certificate Students expecting to graduate should provide an official letter stating expected graduation date, and submit the graduation diploma if admitted, which should be original documents or certified copies in Chinese or English 5. Additional materials Additional materials may be required Note: After passing the initial review, you should mail relevant materials to CUCAS as we tell you through email. Please pay attention to you mailbox
